caption: The image depicts a decorative plate with a detailed central illustration and an ornate border. The plate appears monochromatic, primarily in shades of gray. The central image shows a large, classical-style building with columns and a triangular pediment, on which some words are inscribed. In front of the building, there are several figures and a horse-drawn carriage. Flanking the sides of the main building are smaller structures, including a house with a slanted roof on the left and a multi-story building with windows on the right. The foreground includes people walking and interacting, along with a street scene. The outer rim of the plate is adorned with a floral and foliage pattern, featuring flowers and leaves intricately arranged around the edge. The entire composition is rendered in a realistic style with careful attention to architectural and decorative details, and the scene is framed within the circular boundary of the plate.
title: Plate - "Bank of U.S., Philadelphia"
